entities.summary:
South Italy is one of the five official statistical regions of Italy used by the National Institute of Statistics (ISTAT), a first level NUTS region and a European Parliament constituency. South Italy encompasses six of the country's 20 regions:Abruzzo
Apulia
Basilicata
Calabria
Campania
Molise
